component_guidelines.accordion: Use Shadcn Accordion (single or multiple) with clear section headers, showing badge counter of active tools (e.g., '7 Strumenti').
component_guidelines.drag_and_drop: Allow bakers to reorder tool cards within section or hide them via switch toggle.
component_guidelines.routing: Tool cards must open tools by invoking onSelectTool(toolId) maintaining existing routing integrity.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.test_id_convention: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Format: data-testid='lab-tool-[tool_id]', data-testid='lab-section-[section_id]', data-testid='voice-command-btn', data-testid='lab-mode-toggle'.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers, dialogs, or collapsible cards. Always use minimum bg-[#121212] or bg-[#1E1E1E] with border-[#2C2C2C].
general_ui_ux_guidelines.micro_interactions: Smooth accordion expansion via Framer Motion / standard Shadcn collapsible transitions. Hover states with primary orange highlight (#FF6B00).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use sonner toast notifications for voice command confirmation and tool customization saving.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor tools directory in /frontend/src/components/ToolsDirectory.jsx or relevant section files.
Implement clear 10-section accordion structure as specified in sections_breakdown.
Ensure touch targets are strictly >= 56px-64px with clear text sizes suitable for elderly / hands-free users.
Keep the strict dark color scheme (#121212 background, #1E1E1E card background, #FF6B00 orange primary).
Add persistent Voice Command floating trigger button with data-testid='voice-command-btn'.
Include tool enable/disable toggle switch and drag handle icon on each tool item tile.
Remove all noisy comments, avatars, and superfluous clutter from the main hub top area.
